midpoint_clear_dirty_lower_bounds.derivation: The 4,096,163-byte midpoint partition minus only the one-byte arm and eight-byte modeled-event counter is explicitly written by MidpointClearScratch at every closure. Soft-dirty remains set for a write even when memset restores an already-zero value, so all intersecting canonical leaves must be conservatively rehashed.

v1_cost_diagnosis.external_cost: The external-predictor partition would add the complete CMIX state. Literal reuse of only q1's 26 large-range observer already has a retained lower-bound estimate of at least 6.8 TB of reads on the 250KB population.
v1_cost_diagnosis.decision: Reject every-64 complete-state Merkle roots as an observability design failure before source implementation. This says nothing about midpoint compression value.

component_boundary.component: ByteMixer, its ByteModel base, its owned Lstm, and all midpoint state
component_boundary.environment: The remainder of Predictor, including PPMD, obias, FXCM, contexts, mixers, SSE, the bit head, coder, frontend, and reversible transform.
environment_to_component_calls: ByteMixer::SetOutputBias(bias256 or null) at each modeled-byte update under the bound KH_OBIAS configuration
ByteMixer::SetInput(raw_byte_index, probability) for each active auxiliary row under the bound keep-aux configuration
ByteMixer::ByteUpdate() once per completed modeled byte
ByteMixer::Predict() once after each modeled bit
component_to_environment_values: ByteMixer::Predict()[0] copied to byte_mixer_output after every modeled bit
ByteModel::ex copied to lstmex only; exhaustive bound-source search finds no read of lstmex or lstmpr after their assignments
component_boundary.source_separation: The v4 overlay changes only makefile and Lstm/LstmLayer files. It has no Predictor, manager, model, context, mixer, SSE, bit-head, coder, frontend, or transform pointer/reference and cannot directly write environment state.

causal_noninterference_certificate.base_case: P and K use the same sealed source, seed, compiler contract, pretraining, raw/modeled input, and environment construction. The runtime arm selector is stored only inside the component.
causal_noninterference_certificate.inductive_step: If P and K have equal environment state before bit t and emit bit-identical component boundary output O_t, then deterministic G receives the same O_t and decoded bit x_t, produces equal environment state and equal next component input. The midpoint source cannot bypass this interface.
causal_noninterference_certificate.component_obligation: K performs the same local update arithmetic on detached storage, writes no live parameter or optimizer state, restores and replays hidden/cell state, and aborts at every closure unless its dynamic state equals the captured closure state bit-for-bit.
causal_noninterference_certificate.longitudinal_obligation: A rolling digest covers every component boundary output float bit pattern and count. P/K equality is required for the complete population, not only checkpoint samples.
causal_noninterference_certificate.whole_codec_obligation: Every final uint16 arithmetic probability, payload byte, modeled inverse byte, raw inverse byte, terminal return code, and package member must match P/K exactly.
causal_noninterference_certificate.conclusion_if_all_obligations_pass: K has no behaviorally observable effect on the complete frozen population, and any F/S archive difference is attributable to the only source-authorized live writes inside the component. No claim is made about unobserved populations.

probability.storage: online SHA-256 plus count; no two-byte record file
probability.preimage: Every exact final uint16 probability in little-endian order immediately before the arithmetic split
probability.checkpoints: start, first closure, native-horizon boundary, each fixed population boundary, terminal pre-flush, and finalization
probability.comparisons: encoder/decode within arm, repeats within F/S, and P/K across arms

component_boundary.storage: online SHA-256 plus call count; no per-call record file
component_boundary.preimage: domain tag, modeled-bit ordinal, canonical uint32 bits of ByteMixer::Predict()[0], and canonical int32 bits of ByteModel::ex
component_boundary.why_outputs_only: All component inputs are deterministic functions of equal environment state, the fixed decoded bit stream, and the previous observed component output under the source-bound interface. Recording the derived input vectors would restate the inductive conclusion while hashing about 2 KiB per modeled byte under the bound aux-plus-obias path.
component_boundary.comparisons: P/K complete equality and encoder/decode equality within every arm

midpoint_update.excluded: Full gradients, parameters, optimizer tensors, external state, and cleared scratch are not repeatedly rehashed. Their behavioral consequences remain covered by exact longitudinal outputs, source write-set closure, matched controls, repeats, payloads, and inverses.

sparse_component_state.storage: typed roots over the 130 phase-1 tensors plus the small ByteMixer wrapper at no more than six fixed coordinates per run
sparse_component_state.role: diagnostic localization and terminal repeat evidence, not a substitute for longitudinal output identity
sparse_component_state.dirty_tracking: not required; each sparse coordinate performs one bounded typed rebuild

payload_and_inverse.storage: native finite coder payload/archive plus exact modeled and raw inverse digests
payload_and_inverse.requirements: clean EOF, deterministic repeats, complete package accounting, resources, and independent parser/verifier

matched_controls.P: No midpoint capture, backward, restore, replay, or update.
matched_controls.K: Complete detached midpoint arithmetic plus mandatory dynamic restoration; must equal P on boundary output, final probability, payload, inverse, and terminal sparse component state.
matched_controls.F: Aligned causal targets and authorized live recurrent/output writes.
matched_controls.S: Identical F compute and write shape with only the 16-position target association changed.
matched_controls.repeat: Independent F-A/F-B and S-A/S-B builds/runs must reproduce source, boundary, probability, payload, inverse, update transcript, and package bytes.

promotion_logic.observer_or_identity_failure: Correct observability only; infer no midpoint result.
promotion_logic.P_or_K_divergence: Reject implementation identity and locate the first boundary/update mismatch.
promotion_logic.F_not_better_than_P_or_F_not_better_than: Retire the midpoint causal oracle at that population.
promotion_logic.F_beats_P_K_and_S_at_target_scale: Authorize persistence attribution P/F/J/S as a distinct successor; do not yet claim score credit.
promotion_logic.archive_credit: Only native counted archives with exact inverse and package accounting receive compression evidence; this causal oracle remains zero score credit.

supersession.reason: V5's every-64 six-partition Merkle topology is not proportional to the scientific claim. Full five-partition scans project to multiple terabytes at 10M, and v4's mandatory scratch clear alone forces at least 640,024,062,500 bytes of canonical rehash input before dynamic or external CMIX state. V6 preserves the algorithm and replaces internal omniscience with a source-proved component boundary plus longitudinal exact behavior.
supersession.v5_phase1_reuse: The exact 130-tensor layout remains useful for sparse component-state localization and future implementation visitors.
supersession.v5_soft_dirty_reuse: Parked. Soft-dirty may be reconsidered only for a future genuinely sparse mutation map; it is not part of V6's required evidence.

activation_requirements: Freeze a new compositional observability ABI and receipt schemas; do not edit the v1 ABI or its schemas in place.
Bind an independently reviewed source-interface audit that proves ByteMixer is the complete component/environment boundary for the exact sealed source.
Extend the phase-1 typed layout with the small ByteMixer/ByteModel wrapper state used by the sparse component roots.
Q1-v3 qualification, v4 materialization, a new v6 observability-only source delta, two clean builds, parser independence, and observer-off/on neutrality must pass.
The full-1G lease and lock must be absent before any source materialization, build, fixture, coder, or corpus execution.
No experiment or candidate activation is authorized by this design artifact.
claim_boundary: This is a proof-topology correction, not an implementation or experimental result.
The causal equations are conditional on exact source-interface closure and the declared runtime evidence; they do not predict compression gain.
No midpoint arm has produced an archive, and all Gamma compression and Hutter score credits remain zero.
The external cmix-obias baseline, q1 live gate, and all prior receipts remain unchanged.
